text.p: Finnish food, sweetener and enzymes group Cultor Oy said in a statement on Tuesday its full-year 1996 result would be above previous forecasts and earnings per share would be over 12 markka.

"We now expect better figures, giving us earnings per share in excess of 12 markka," Cultor said in a statement, noting that it last said in October that its 1996 earnings per share would be down by about a quarter on 14.91 markka of 1995.
Cultor also said its 1996 net sales were 8.4 billion markka, up 35 percent on 1995.
The increase in net sales was substantially the result of acquisitions made during the year, it said.
Cultor said the last four months were the best in 1996.

"In the latter part of the year, we also succeeded in eliminating the negative impact caused by high raw material costs," Cultor said, adding that the businesses acquired from Pfizer made a positive contribution to the earnings.
